note: Default training growth curve: how much each main stat rises PER training level (0-30). Training raises a player's stats; every 5 levels unlocks a rank up, and each rank raises the max training level by 5 (so max level = 5 x rank, capped at 30). FC Mobile's real per-level gains differ PER PLAYER and were not verifiable from a free public source. This is a placeholder default; each player can override it with their own growth values in the UI (Player form -> Growth). You can also move training between players via Training Transfer (see rules/costs.json). Effective stat at a hypothetical level = current stat + gain_per_level * (target_level - current_level).
